Why did Salazar Slytherin REALLY leave Hogwarts? The four founders were once the closest of friends, but their falling-out divided the school for a thousand years. What could have gone so wrong?

Today, Ben dives into the Wizarding World of Harry Potter to discuss three theories about Salazar Slytherin’s tragic story: whether his pureblood beliefs began with fear, whether a personal loss fractured his friendship with the founders, and whether a prophecy about his descendants led him to try to prevent the rise of Lord Voldemort.

From Godric Gryffindor and the Sorting Hat to the Chamber of Secrets, the Gaunt family, and the power of love, could Slytherin’s attempts to protect the wizarding world have helped create its darkest enemy?
